decisions.reason: The sheet preparation module builds on the established portfolio, still has its own page in 2024, and costs a wholesaler little to keep listed, so the option is worth keeping open while its value in automated workflows becomes clearer.

The folding add-on unit is close to the core offer, has a documented customer installation that shows real inline value, and is cheap to keep as an accessory to the Touchline range, although its lower website visibility suggests a modest risk of quiet removal.
